requiredFindings.title: Correct the false TS2 aggregate-bound claim in the frozen scope
requiredFindings.detail: SCOPE.md LD-D2B3C-1 says the TS2 spool operates under an existing aggregate bound, but accepted LD-D2B-8 explicitly sets no TS2 aggregate response bound and the actual Spool::push is unbounded. Produce an exact successor whose scope states that individual frame admission bounds still apply while the aggregate TS2 spool remains uncapped; do not add a product cap without separate authority. Re-freeze and rehash the corrected package, preserving source and evidence bytes if otherwise unchanged.
